components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width filled action with a minimum 52px height.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 64px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #174D45; color: #fff; font: 600 16px/1.25 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined secondary action using the shared button geometry.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 64px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid #174D45; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; color: #174D45; font: 600 16px/1.25 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis text action with a 48px minimum target.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 48px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; color: #174D45; font: 600 16px/1.25 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Filled, rounded field with a tonal outline and primary focus border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #20332E; font: 500 13px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 15px 16px; border: 1px solid #D8D2C5; border-radius: 12px; background: #EAE4D7; color: #20332E; font: 400 15px/1.45 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border: 2px solid #174D45; outline: none; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped state label with optional icon and semantic tint.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #D1FADF; color: #05603A; font: 600 13px/1.35 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The shared visual language treats a care request as a legible visit record: warm paper-like surfaces, deep green text and actions, restrained status color, and compactly organized details. It is calm and practical rather than a generic dashboard; the record card brings status, visit facts, and the next action into one readable unit.

Both apps use the same Material 3 theme foundation, Plus Jakarta Sans, spacing, shapes, and shared UI widgets. The home surfaces differ by role—Care-Flash foregrounds starting or following a request; Care-Merchant foregrounds caregiver readiness and the request or active visit—while retaining the same record-first card grammar.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, lightly ruled surfaces with deep green as the shared brand seed.
Distinct status tints and restrained gold/terracotta accents.
Reused typography, component shapes, and page width across both apps.

rules.name: The Shared Seed Rule
rules.body: Care-Flash and Care-Merchant use the same green seed by default; optional appearance accents replace the seed and regenerate the Material 3 scheme.

rules.name: The Shared Type Rule
rules.body: Use the Plus Jakarta Sans Material scale across both apps; distinguish record metadata through size, weight, and semantic color, not a second typeface.

rules.name: The Ruled-Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate shared cards with tone and a subtle border, not a drop shadow.

dos: Do use the shared green-seeded Material 3 theme and shared typography, spacing, and radius scales by default.
Do keep status meaning explicit through semantic colors and labels, and maintain readable contrast between each container and foreground.
Do organize a visit record so its current state and actionable next step are easy to find.
Do preserve the 680px home content maximum and 20px page gutter where using the established home layout.
donts: Don't add drop shadows to the shared flat card treatment.
Don't use status colors as interchangeable decoration; success, warning, and danger are separate semantic states.
Don't promote one app's home composition into a mandatory layout for every screen; the shared system supports role-specific workflows.
